question: Why are the great majority of burglar alarm calls to the police false alarms?
answer: Because burglaries are rare and alarms are many. A home alarm stands guard for thousands of hours for every real break-in, so even a small daily chance of a false trigger, from pets, wind or a fumbled code, outnumbers genuine alerts. A US police guide put false alarms at 94 to 98% of calls.
move: Count the quiet hours an alarm watches before trusting its rings.
ask: Which alarm in my life, a worry or a warning sign, goes off far more often than the real thing happens?
source: Sampson, False Burglar Alarms, US DOJ, 2011
reference: Sampson, False Burglar Alarms, 2nd ed., Problem-Oriented Guides for Police No. 5, US Department of Justice, 2011
